svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step resist covers the oxide-filled trench and a wide stack on it, and deep doped regions lie in both active areas. After it the resist is gone and a thin oxide covers everything.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step resist covers the oxide-filled trench and a wide stack on it, and deep doped regions lie in both active areas. After it the resist is gone and a thin oxide covers everything.
svg.text: Before: the NSDM resist after the N+ implant (step 086)
The implanted resist is ashed and the wafer
given a pre-anneal clean, sparing the oxide.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
